_source: myExpertSites -> MyExpertSitesResponse { success, message, error, metadata, data: [ExpertSiteEntity!] }. Introspected live at http://localhost:3067/graphql. THE RELATION FENCE: my-expert-sites.service.ts selects relations { offerings: true } and nothing else, and the resolver carries no @ResolveField, so catalogOrder, instance and user are NULL on the wire for every row. They are written out as explicit nulls rather than omitted, because that is what the transport actually says - a fixture that put catalogOrder.catalogItem.name on one of these rows would be inventing the very field this case refuses to assert. NO refused state: this service cannot throw. NO pagination: the query takes zero arguments and returns the complete set, so there is no total, cursor or hasMore a fixture may carry.
